A stronger candidate game specification: build affection, creative ownership and satisfying progress. Reviewed and rebuilt from all 23 source sheets. This is not a guarantee of retention, spending or commercial success.
START HERE  •  Dashboard → Critical Audit → Rules → Catalogs → Balance Tests → Release Plan
WHAT THIS VERSION CHANGES

Safe offline growth; mature fish settle once, then Keep or Rehome with the same payout. Paid companions and all decor are permanent, nonproducing cosmetics. Capacity can use coins OR pearls, with no mandatory friends.
WHAT IS INSIDE

40 launch coin species • 72 coin species planned • 27 companion concepts • all 120 decor items and full art briefs • 70-level planning curve with L40 launch cap • 10 cosmetic projects • 8 simulated play styles × 120 days.
READ THE NUMBERS CORRECTLY

Gold cells are candidate tuning inputs; formulas update catalog/XP comparisons. Daily Ledger and progression scenarios are FROZEN simulation outputs. Editing Excel does not rerun player behavior. The companion Python model/config regenerates CSVs. Model Contract includes a numeric freshness warning; text/ID/rule changes also require a rerun.
IMPLEMENTATION ORDER

Build the four-fish vertical slice and transactional server first. Test care, keeping favorites and scene creation with real players before producing the full catalog. Enable only asset-complete IDs and reachable rewards. Do not activate future levels merely because they appear in the planning table.
KNOWN LIMITS — DO NOT HIDE THESE

Finite sinks eventually run out, especially for the optimizer and pearl-funded-capacity actors. Live retention, fun, cosmetic demand, refunds, ad revenue, operating costs and acquisition economics are not measured. Runtime transaction safety, device performance and store approval still require verification. PASS means only the named calculation or modeled scenario.

The free path works in these actors: one or two visits a day, no ads and no purchases. Keeping favorites does not sacrifice payout. All 960 modeled daily cash balances reconcile. Runtime and player validation are still outstanding.

At day 120 the core actor holds about 13.6 reference coin-days; the optimizer holds about 75.1. Projects and decor are finite. Validate whether players actually want more creative content before adding sinks. Do not erase wealth with punitive maintenance, fish loss or expiring currency.
